blocking_issues: M-1 (pycore-runtime-G1, first item): pycore/pyctl/agent_history/agent_history_service.py:415 reads prompt_archive.ARCHIVE_ROOT_ONLY_FIELD, which pycore/pyctl/agent_history/prompt_archive.py does not define (hasattr is False; the static module-attribute check flags only this site). Every _extract_inner pass with at least one changed source that holds a prompt raises AttributeError inside the per-session generator (:406-418). That happens before write_index, write_prompts and write_state (:480-496), so the except at :511-515 returns {'error': "module 'pycore.pyctl.agent_history.prompt_archive' has no attribute 'ARCHIVE_ROOT_ONLY_FIELD'"}. Nothing is stored, no sessions-changed or prompt-new event fires, and live_scan never updates its baseline, so it re-extracts on every tick. Fix: define ARCHIVE_ROOT_ONLY_FIELD (a key-name constant) at the top of prompt_archive.py, add it to __all__, and make archive_prompts consume it (next issue). Do not delete the caller line. After the fix, rerun the scratch module-attribute check (import pycore.x as alias; alias.NAME must exist) over pycore/pyctl/agent_history.

AHSC-28 completion (pycore-runtime-G1, with M-1): pycore/pyctl/agent_history/prompt_archive.py:35 PROMPT_ARCHIVE_FILE_MODE = 0o666 and :107-111 (chmod only on create, then 'except OSError: pass') remain. Follow the spool policy: reuse root_spool.SPOOL_FILE_MODE (0o640, root_spool.py:45) or move that constant down to one shared place; do not add a second 0o640 literal. Pick the mode from the ARCHIVE_ROOT_ONLY_FIELD of the batch. The archive is one JSONL per tool, so a file that receives any root-only entry is restricted, and a restricted file is never widened again. Other files keep the owner default (no chmod). Skip chmod/chown on os.name == 'nt' with a condition, not an except. Log a chmod failure with ColorPrint (path, mode, errno) instead of passing. Keep the flag out of, or explicit in, _ARCHIVE_ENTRY_FIELDS by decision, and record the choice in the report. Give the agent_history_txt.py store (:39-48 store_dir/sessions_dir) the same restricted modes. Verify: a grep of pycore/pyctl/agent_history finds no 0o666; py_compile passes; a WSL Debian scratch run in a temp dir asserts 0640 for a root-only sample; on Windows chmod is skipped without error.
